== Biography ==
James Glasgow was baptised at Edinburgh on 18 April 1680 as a son of [[Glasgow-2682|James Glasgow]] and [[Duffe-18|Isobell Duffe]].<ref>“Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950,” FamilySearch database, James Glasgow, 18 April 1680, Edinburgh, [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQC9-8SW record VQC9-8SW].</ref> The structured date and place are retained as uncertain birth details because the indexed event is a baptism, not a separately stated birth.

The same parents had another son named James baptised in March 1679, represented by the separate profile [[Glasgow-3103|James Glasgow]]. The two baptismal profiles should not be merged. Reuse of the name makes it plausible that the elder child died young and that the 1680 child survived, but no burial or other record inspected so far proves that hypothesis.

== Research Notes ==
=== Current father-profile assessment, 20 October 2026 ===

The 1696 apothecary apprentice is a compatible later identity; no adult family or apprenticeship is assigned to this baptism.

This 1680 child remains a compatible childhood comparison for the 1696 apothecary apprentice [[[Glasgow-4114|James Glasgow (Glasgow-4114)]]](/people/glasgow-4114.html), whose preferred father account is now [[[Glasgow-2682|James Glasgow (Glasgow-2682)]]](/people/glasgow-2682.html), probable 82%. The 1679 [same-name child](/people/glasgow-3103.html) remains separate. Name reuse favours testing this child as the survivor but does not identify the apprentice or Jean Dobie’s husband. No adult records, spouse or new mother are transferred.<ref>[https://www.tradeshouselibrary.org/uploads/4/7/7/2/47723681/edinburgh_apprentices_~_1666_to_1700_~_1929.pdf#page=47 Watson, Edinburgh Apprentices (1929), printed p.37, PDF p.47: James 1696 and Thomas 1699; printed page inspected 18 October, reused]; [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQC9-N9X Thomas, 13 November 1684: maintained FamilySearch baptism citation]; [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQC9-Q9J James, 16 March 1679: retained separate child comparison]; [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQC9-8S4 James, 18 April 1680: retained separate child comparison]; [https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:FM3W-XBN Margaret, 20 March 1691: later daughter, not a younger son]. Prior inspected printed register and maintained baptism citations; no new original inspection.</ref>

It has not been established which child, if either, became the adult James associated with Jean Dobie and the family recorded from 1699. No spouse, child or adult event should be moved or attached to this profile without an identifying marriage, burial, testament or equivalent record.

Research priorities are Edinburgh burials in 1679-1680 and a marriage record for James Glasgow and Jean Dobie.
